If a tool returns an error, read it, fix the call, and try again. Stop as soon as you have the answer.

Draw a Mermaid flowchart of this process. A customer places an order. If the item is in stock, it is packed and shipped. If it is not in stock, the customer is offered a backorder. If they accept, the order waits for a restock and is then packed and shipped. If they decline, the order is refunded.
Limits: at most 20 lines. Answer with the Mermaid code only, with no explanation.

output.content:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Customer places order] --> B{Item in stock?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Pack item]
    C --> D[Ship order]
    D --> E[Order complete]
    B -->|No| F[Offer backorder]
    F --> G{Accept backorder?}
    G -->|Yes| H[Wait for restock]
    H --> C
    G -->|No| I[Refund order]
    I --> J[Order cancelled]
```
